depth.notes: Total frontmost rim to rear endpoint; not installed rear projection.

flangeAssemblyDepth.notes: Frontmost flange/gasket face to rear mounting datum. Does not establish individual metal or compressed gasket thickness.

mountingFaceOffset.notes: Rear underside of flange/gasket is z=0; frontmost rim has negative z.

rearProjection.notes: 96 mm total depth - 9 mm front-to-mounting offset = 87 mm.

cutoutDiameter.notes: Recommended baffle cutout; do not substitute the smaller basket neck dimension.

basketNeckDiameter.notes: Dimensioned basket neck below flange; distinct from recommended baffle cutout.

boltStartAngle.notes: Pattern phase read from the rear view; holes or slots are rotationally symmetric. Angle measured from model +x.

driverDisplacement.notes: Published occupied air volume; 1 dm3 = 1 L. Never integrated from the appearance mesh.

terminalClearance.notes: No dimensioned cable bend, tool or installation clearance in these sources.

boltSlotWidth.notes: Tangential slot width, not a round-hole diameter.

boltSlotLength.notes: Drawing dimensions width only; slot length remains unresolved.

magnetDiameter.notes: Appearance-only diameter scaled from dimensioned side drawing; not a published dimension or verified collision surface.

magnetStartZ.notes: Appearance-only basket-to-motor transition scaled along side view from mounting datum.

geometry.datum: mounting face z=0; positive z rearward. Rear underside of flange/gasket is datum; frontmost rim z=-9 mm and rear endpoint z=87 mm.

parts.name: Maximum clearance envelope
parts.notes: Conservative full-depth circumscribed screening cylinder, not driver material or displaced air volume.

parts.name: Circular flange appearance
parts.notes: Published outer and axial bounds; unverified inner opening represented by basket neck. Holes/slots are separate guides, not subtracted voids.

parts.name: Baffle cutout guide
parts.notes: 0.4 mm display stroke marking the manufacturer recommended cutout, not driver material.

parts.name: Mounting pitch-circle guide
parts.notes: Known mounting pitch circle. Slot length is unavailable so no exact slot outline is rendered.

parts.name: Basket appearance surface
parts.notes: Approximate side-view basket envelope without ribs/windows; not a solid or certified fit surface. Intermediate contour is visual only.

parts.name: External motor appearance
parts.notes: External silhouette only; cover steps, pole vents and internals are not asserted. Even dimensioned overall motor bounds do not make this approximate profile exact CAD.

unresolved: Mounting slots have 5.5 mm width but no published length; exact slot machining/export remains unavailable.
Cone, dustcap, surround and acoustic front-chamber profiles are not dimensioned; no profiles or cone-depth values are invented.
Basket windows, ribs, motor internals and local flange recesses are not reconstructed; visible exterior surfaces are explicitly approximate.
Gasket compression, manufacturing tolerances and installed terminal/cable clearance require manufacturer confirmation or real-part measurement.
Published small-signal motor data supports response screening; MEH suitability still requires the selected horn, loading, excursion, thermal and crossover checks.
notes: Compact 209 mm frame and 1.25 kg neodymium alternative; higher Qts than 8NDL64.
All motor values are from the exact 8-ohm datasheet; no other model or impedance variant supplies parameters.
Manufacturer drawings were visually inspected; rendered reconstructions are not manufacturer CAD.
Acoustic occupied volume uses the published value, never the full clearance envelope or approximate appearance mesh.
